messages:
olivia: Heads-up: planning a kernel swap + quant build rollout during the quiet window tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC. Target image: runtime-kernel@v2.15-quantlz4. I ran a short staging sweep earlier — basic smoke looks ok but we need final ops signoff and a pin/rollback plan.

raj: thanks. quick note: last week we saw a small increase in KV cache misses after a similar swap in eu-west. recommend staggered regional slices, not global flip.

sophia: agreed with @raj. propose 10% -> 40% -> 100% slices with 15m dwell and perf checks. we should also enable model-fallback routing in the first two slices.

mike: i'll own rollback and traffic steering. if latency p50 rises >20ms or error-rate >0.5% for 3 consecutive mins, we rollback. who triggers? ops oncall?

jenna: ops can trigger but prefer automated rollback on the deploybot for speed. deploy-bot can unpin and flip back to v2.14 in one step.

deploy-bot: @channel scheduled image deploy accepted: runtime-kernel@v2.15-quantlz4 -> canary slice 10% at 2024-11-05T00:30:00Z. Pin TTL: 4h. To cancel run: `/deploy cancel 1748502461`

olivia: thanks. jenna, ops-bot preflight and smoke hooks? can you post checklist here so i can add to release notes?

ops-bot: preflight status: cluster-health OK, node-drain capacity sufficient, kv-cache telemetry hooks present. smoke script exit codes: 0/5. Canary metrics to watch: p50, p95, cpu, kv_miss_rate, model_fallback_rate.

raj: add a quick script to validate KV cache hit ratio after ~2k requests: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://telemetry.internal/api/kv_cache?window=5m` — look for hit_ratio > 0.92.

eva: I'll update release notes and changelog. Draft snippet: "runtime: kernel v2.15 with lz4 quant path — improves memory footprint and throughput for GPU v4-class. Rollout under quiet window with staged slices; automatic fallback to v2.14 enabled." Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/release-notes/1748502461-draft

mike: for rollback steps (owned by me):
```
1) /deploy cancel 1748502461 (stop the canary)
2) /deploy pin runtime-kernel@v2.14 --globally
3) revert routing rule `quant-route` to fallback model set
4) notify customers + incident channel if >1000 requests impacted
```

jenna: ops will monitor, i'll keep the pager open. ops-bot please ensure alerts are unmuted for that window.

ops-bot: alerts unmuted. smoke alert thresholds set: p50 +20ms, error-rate 0.5%. if triggered, will notify @mike and #eng-oncall.

olivia: decision: proceed with staged slices as @sophia suggested. can everyone on-thread ack their ownership? i want a single point of contact for the 00:30-01:30UTC window.

raj: ack - monitoring slice telemetry and will post short sampling every 15m.

sophia: ack - will pause at each dwell and confirm gating.

mike: ack - rollback owner.

eva: ack - release notes posted and PR opened for changelog.

jenna: ack - ops lead for drain/rollout.

olivia: perfect. final checklist for the thread: 1) deploy-bot scheduled (done) 2) ops preflight OK (done) 3) staged slices + gating (agreed) 4) rollback automation (mike) 5) release notes link (eva). i'll ping again 30m before window start. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: kernel-swap canary at 2024-11-05T00:30:00Z. Good luck! :rocket:
